scripts.setup: npm install && (cd frontend && npm install) && (cd backend && npm install)
scripts.format: docker compose -f docker-compose.check.yml run --rm frontend sh -c 'npm install && npm run format' && docker compose -f docker-compose.check.yml run --rm backend sh -c 'npm install && npm run format'
scripts.check: docker compose -f docker-compose.check.yml run --rm frontend sh -c 'npm install && npm run check' && docker compose -f docker-compose.check.yml run --rm backend sh -c 'npm install && npm run check'
